## Summary

What changed?

Adds `LIAISONS.md`, the liaison roster and cross-WG intake tracker asked for in #11, and links it from the Start Here list in the README and from the Cross-WG and External Coordination section of WORKING-METHODS.md.

The tracker covers the six external groups named in charter section 8 (OpenTelemetry GenAI SIG, OWASP AOS, W3C Trace Context, Agent Trace, Monocle, AGNTCY), the internal AAIF coordination points (Technical Committee, MCP, Goose, the four sibling WGs, and the Taxonomy & Landscape workstream with its known sync cadence), plus inbound and outbound tables seeded only with items that exist today as real issues. Every liaison cell reads `needs owner` because no source currently names a person, with the Chairs as default contact per the charter's external representation policy. Statuses use the WORKING-METHODS.md vocabulary and the document carries the standard living document freshness marker.

Two sourcing notes for reviewers. The `cursor/agent-trace` GitHub repository cited in some third party write ups does not resolve as of 2026-08-22, so the roster links the live specification site agent-trace.dev instead and flags the discrepancy. The inbound and outbound tables intentionally hold two rows each rather than a rounder number, since only those items could be traced to real issues.

## Related Issue

Closes #11

## Review Notes

What should reviewers focus on?

- Whether the seeded inbound rows (aaif/wg-security-and-privacy#13 and aaif/ws-taxonomy-landscape#15) and outbound rows (#10 and #12 in this repo) are the right starting set.
- Whether the WG wants named liaison nominations recorded here or tracked in issues first.
- Any external group descriptions that a practitioner closer to those groups would word differently.

## Follow-ups

What remains after this PR?

- Nominating liaisons for the entries marked `needs owner`, per charter section 8.
- Updating the tracker at the before and after meeting checkpoints WORKING-METHODS.md already defines.

## Checklist

- [x] Linked the relevant issue, meeting note, or action item
- [x] Updated issue status or next step if needed
- [x] Added or updated a freshness/status marker for living documents, if applicable
